description: Source code for 'git ls-files' command, handling file listing, filtering, and display options within a Git repository.

methods.name: write_eolinfo
methods.description: Outputs line ending and attribute info for a file if show_eol is enabled.

methods.name: write_name
methods.description: Outputs a file name, quoted and relative to the prefix.

methods.name: write_name_to_buf
methods.description: Appends a relative file name to a string buffer.

methods.name: get_tag
methods.description: Returns a tag string based on cache entry flags and display options.

methods.name: print_debug
methods.description: Prints debug info about a cache entry if debug_mode is enabled.

methods.name: show_dir_entry
methods.description: Displays a directory entry with tag and line ending info.

methods.name: show_other_files
methods.description: Displays files marked as 'other' in the directory.

methods.name: show_killed_files
methods.description: Displays files that are on the filesystem but not in the index (killed).

methods.name: show_files
methods.description: Main function to display files based on various filters and options.

methods.name: prune_index
methods.description: Prunes the index to only include entries starting with a given prefix.

methods.name: get_common_prefix_len
methods.description: Calculates the length of the common prefix, trimming trailing slash.

methods.name: cmd_ls_files
methods.description: Main function implementing the 'git ls-files' command, parsing options, preparing index, and displaying files.
